title: ac-report@1
description: The verify-ac payload (02 §6): one element per acceptance criterion, each a per-AC judgment with its evidence. Routing is computed over `status` by the verify step's thresholds — `any(status == unmet)` and `any(status == unverifiable)` (05 §1) — which are equality predicates and need no declared order; `status` is therefore an ordinary enum, deliberately not an `ordered_enum`, because these three values form no ladder and inventing one would let `>=` compile against a comparison nobody defined.

id.description: The acceptance criterion's identifier, matching the issue body's AC section.

status.description: The per-AC judgment (02 §6). `unverifiable` covers both an AC whose fenced command fell outside the operator's trust allowlist — reported, never executed (06 §4) — and one that is runtime-only or too defective in its wording to judge.

evidence.description: What a skeptic could re-run or re-read: the recorded pre-gate command result, or the file:line trace through the diff.

classification.description: How the AC was verified: `command` (the engine ran it as a pre-gate at claim and the result arrived in the context bundle), `static` (traced through the diff), or `runtime` (observable only by running the system, hence never verified statically).
